info.name: Byond Kids — Backend API v3
info.description:
Complete API collection for Byond Kids backend.

## Quick Start
1. Set `base_url` → `http://localhost:4000`
2. Run **Login Admin** → `admin_token` tersimpan otomatis
3. Run **Login Parent** → `parent_token` + `parent_refresh` tersimpan
4. Run **GET Family Children** → `child_profile_id` tersimpan
5. Run **Login Child (Aisha)** → `child_token` + `child_refresh` tersimpan

## Seed Credentials
| Role | Identifier | Password | PIN |
|------|-----------|---------|-----|
| SUPER_ADMIN | admin@byond.id | Admin@Byond2026! | — |
| PARENT | budi.santoso@demo.byond.id | Byond@2026 | 123456 |
| CHILD 1 (Aisha) | aisha_byond | 123456 | 123456 |
| CHILD 2 (Rizky) | rizky_byond | 654321 | 654321 |

## RBAC
- `[PUBLIC]` — Tidak perlu token
- `[PARENT]` — Bearer `{{parent_token}}`
- `[CHILD]` — Bearer `{{child_token}}`
- `[ADMIN]` — Bearer `{{admin_token}}`
- `[ANY]` — Token valid (PARENT atau CHILD)

request.description: Status dasar server. Tidak perlu token.

Login CHILD Aisha. 3-factor: username + password + pin (PIN 6 digit).

Saves `child_token`, `child_refresh`, `child_profile_id`.
Login CHILD Rizky (anak ke-2). Ganti `child_token` jika ingin test dengan Rizky.
Dapatkan access token baru menggunakan refresh token. Refresh token lama diinvalidasi (rotasi).
Logout orang tua — invalidasi refresh token. Access token tetap valid sampai expire (8 menit).
Logout anak — invalidasi refresh token anak.

Request reset password link via email.

Anti-enumeration: always returns 200 regardless of whether email exists.
Rate limit: 5 req / 15 min per IP.
Token valid for 15 minutes (single-use).

Apply new password using token from email link.

Token is 64-char hex (32 random bytes, SHA-256 hashed in DB).
Single-use: token is marked usedAt after redemption.
Force logout: all active sessions are invalidated on success.
